opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research. Two funding rounds per year (Stage 1 opens 20 Nov and 14 May; Stage 1 deadlines 5 Jan and 1 July; Stage 2 deadlines 1 March and 1 September; decisions June and December).

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme; holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally refurbishing or creating new galleries. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces for sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme; holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, with performing arts as the vast majority of activities. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally building or refurbishing facilities and occasionally purchasing specialist equipment. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally refurbishing or creating new galleries. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working with disability, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help people with disabilities live more independently, focusing on training, employment and supported housing, especially for young people transitioning from children's to adults' services. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated, with at least a 'Good' CQC rating where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority supporting special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects supporting pupils at secondary level to develop skills to gain employment or live independently after school or college. Two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: High-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results and a 'Good' or above inspection outcome.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects requiring specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts). 2026 funding round is now closed; next round details expected in spring 2027.
